scope: All failed latest-attempt run records in this bounded main-branch inventory. Successful/skipped/cancelled records remain separate; earlier attempts of later-successful runs are not retroactively counted as failures.
interpretation: Multiple audits often report the same underlying source/consumer defect; 89 failed jobs are not 89 independent root causes. Historical failures are preserved. No rerun, baseline acceptance, secret/configuration change, provider acquisition, email or trade was performed for this census.
